prompt: A young human wizard in cerulean and sapphire-blue robes stands in three-quarter view at a wooden lectern, hunched and reacting as another mage's spell flares behind him. A single fresh page glowing with soft blue runes flies up into his right hand from an open spellbook on the lectern; from his left hand a spent, ash-edged, crumbling page tumbles downward toward the floor, the two pages streaking in opposite directions. The only strong light is the blue rune-glow on the rising page. The background is a dim stone study with a tall bookshelf and a faint blue spell-flash.
